query:
SELECT p.id, p.residentId, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.isActive, p.startDate, p.endDate,
       (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) as remaining,
       NOW() as now,
       CASE WHEN NOW() > p.endDate THEN 'EXPIRED_BY_DATE' ELSE 'NOT_EXPIRED' END as date_status
FROM packages p
WHERE p.id IN (480001, 450011, 390001)
ORDER BY p.id;
